messages:
kevin: heads up — eu-central GPU pool reporting multiple node preemptions, pod churn ~25% last 5m. latency tail for gen routes spiking, TTL hitting 8s on short prompts. I'm starting soft-evac plan.

anika: can we buffer and redirect traffic gradually? my suggestion: shift 30% to na-west as primary buffer and 15% to eu-west as standby. keep short-route TTL at 10s, avoid hard failover.

josh: on it. preparing a gradual steer. will start with a 5% canary to na-west for 2m then ramp.

josh: running command:
```
/gslb update --policy-id policy-473 --set-weight eu-central=55,eu-west=15,na-west=30 --strategy=gradual --ramp=120s
```

deploy-bot: GSLB update submitted — policy=policy-473, change_id=chg-20260318-01, status=queued.

ops-bot: Observability snapshot: eu-central gen P95 1.9s -> 3.7s, P99 spiked to 7.8s, error rate +0.8% (5m). link: https://console.redwood/obs/alerts/alpha

maria: cost note — moving load to na-west will increase egress/inter-region transfer. quick estimate: ~+$4.6k/day if shift held at 30% for >12h. consider enabling prefix caching to reduce tokens out.

anika: good call. enable kv-prefix caching for active sessions in na-west and set batching target 64 for short prompts. that should reduce unit cost and smooth tail.

josh: change applied. gradual ramp started; canary 5% to na-west for 2m. monitoring metrics in the steering dashboard.

sre-oncall: I'll watch error thresholds. rollback criteria: sustained error delta >1% for 3m or latency P99 >10s. @josh tag me if we hit either.

kevin: opening incident page for tracking: https://incident.redwood/INC-2026-045 — logging preemptions and node ids.

deploy-bot: GSLB change in-progress: weights now eu-central=70,na-west=15,eu-west=15 (canary stage). change_id=chg-20260318-01, eta_full_ramp=120s.

josh: early signs: eu-central tail latency dropping after canary, P95 down to ~2.1s. continuing ramp to target weights.

maria: :thumbsup: keep cost/time updates if this runs long.

sre-oncall: noting: alerting for regional cooling capacity, paging infra-team if preemptions continue beyond 30m.

kevin: thanks all — will post summary in 15m once ramp stabilizes.
